project_context.name: TriviaStream
project_context.primary_persona: Multiplayer live trivia participants (mobile) and hosts (desktop)

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
scale.pin_display: text-[12vw] font-black tracking-widest leading-none text-white drop-shadow-[0_10px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]

typography.instructions: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Emphasize wide, heavy fonts for headers to create a TV game show feel. All numeric PIN displays must be massive and highly contrasted.

colors.instructions: Use deep purple for backgrounds with lavender and peach accents for cards/surfaces. Game tiles MUST map exactly to the provided colors and integrate their respective shapes (CSS clip-path or SVGs) to ensure colorblind accessibility.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Heavy, soft tinted shadows: shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(46,16,101,0.15)] for cards, and sharp pop-out shadows for buttons: shadow-[0_6px_0_#1e1b4b] to give a tactile arcade button feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thick pill shapes for badges, massive rounded corners on cards (rounded-3xl or rounded-[2rem]).
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating UI elements over deep purple backgrounds (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10). Solid crisp white (bg-white) for question cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use background image textures softly blended into the deep purple.

layouts.landing_page: Bento Grid approach. Split screen or asymmetrical layout with the Hero Image on one side, and two distinct bold CTAs on the other (Host: Create Game, Player: Enter PIN).
layouts.host_lobby: Massive 1-column header for PIN (text-[12vw]), followed by a dense, animated multi-column grid of player nickname pills. Background must be energetic with floating shapes or deep purple/lavender gradients.
layouts.quiz_builder: High-density dashboard layout. Left rail for questions list, main center area for editing the active question. Form inputs should be chunky, friendly, and accessible.
layouts.player_mobile_join: Strictly mobile-first. Massive touch targets. The PIN and Nickname entry screens should have input fields taking up 80% width with pill-shaped massive buttons (h-16).
layouts.player_waiting_room: Immersive full-screen view with a pulsing/breathing animation on the 'You\'re in!' text or background to keep the player engaged while waiting.
layouts.error_states: Playful, full-screen takeover modal/pages with large typography ('Uh oh! Room Full') and an easy pill-shaped CTA to go back. No generic toast alerts for these core flow blocks.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all buttons must scale up (scale-105) and increase shadow depth. Tapping a tile should have a swift 'press' down (active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none).
motion.page_transitions: Player joining the lobby should trigger a subtle framer-motion pop-in animation on the host screen.

components.AnswerTile: A massive interactive button component requiring props for color and shape. Render the shape prominently (SVG) inside the button. For mobile, the tile should take up 50% of the grid.
components.PlayerBadge: A thick, pill-shaped badge (rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-2) displaying the player's nickname.
components.GameInput: Custom massive input field. text-center, rounded-2xl, thick border (focus:ring-4 focus:ring-accent-peach bg-white text-indigo-950 font-black text-3xl placeholder:text-gray-300 h-20).

landing_hero.description: Friends playing games on their phones. Place this in the hero section of the landing page to establish the social gaming context.

background_texture.description: Abstract 3D floating purple glass shapes. Use as a heavily blurred/blended background image to give an energetic TV-show feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write the frontend using standard .js files, NOT .tsx (TypeScript).
You MUST NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Import 'Clash Display' or 'Outfit' via fontsource for headings, and 'Nunito' for body text.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for UI icons (heavy/bold variants).
Answer tiles on the host screen and player mobile view MUST clearly depict a Red Triangle, Blue Diamond, Yellow Circle, and Green Square using clear, scalable SVGs.
Implement motion using framer-motion for smooth pop-ins and staggered lists when players join the lobby.
Ensure all interactable elements have data-testid attributes.
For the quiz builder, create a highly tactile form. Use Shadcn component structures but customize them completely to look like playful game UI.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
